About the stock : Somany Ceramics is the second largest tiles manufacturer in the domestic tiles market having ~80 MSM capacity along with bath fittings and sanitaryware capacity of 1.3 mn pieces and 0.48 mn pieces, respectively. • The company has guided for mid-single digit volume growth in FY27 and sustaining double digits margins.

Q 2F Y2 7 performance : Somany Ceramics delivered a strong Q2FY27 performance, with consolidated revenue from operations rising 25.4% YoY to ₹854 crore, driven by strong tiles revenues growth amidst price hikes.

Tile volumes grew 5.4% YoY to 18.77 MSM, led by a 15.3% increase in own manufacturing volumes to 6.84 MSM, while JV and outsourced volumes remained largely stable at 4.98 MSM and 6.95 MSM, respectively.
